primitives.name: Restless Locomotor Activity
primitives.verbatim_quote: TYPICAL STUDIES OF SEXUALLY MOTIVATED ACTIVITY Richter has also shown that the male rat displays much more restless locomotor activity when the sex drive is operating than when it is not.
primitives.assumptions: Activity is proportional to motivational intensity; measurable via automated tracking systems.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Zero activity when motivational drive is absent or suppressed.

layer2.mapping: Activity pattern serves as proxy for internal motivational state in GSI's Bayesian model; used in GSE for dynamic state transitions based on behavioral thresholds.
layer2.telemetry: Rotational movement frequency in revolving cage

primitives.name: Revolving Cage Kinematics
primitives.verbatim_quote: He placed male rats in drum-like cages pivoted on a central axis in such a way that if the animal attempted to climb the circular side of the cage its weight would turn the drum.
primitives.assumptions: Cage rotation directly correlates with animal effort; system is frictionless for idealized modeling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Angular velocity approaches zero when animal ceases movement.

layer2.mapping: Kinematic response mirrors behavioral arousal; GSE uses this isomorphism to infer motivational states from mechanical motion.
layer2.telemetry: Rotational frequency of cage during activity epochs

primitives.name: Activity Cycle Pattern
primitives.verbatim_quote: Wang (4) has shown by analogous means that the female rat is maximally active in this same restless fashion about every fourth day, the two or three days between showing a relatively small amount of activity.
primitives.assumptions: Activity follows periodic oscillation; intrinsic biological rhythm governs behavior.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Cycle period diverges under hormonal disruption or environmental stress.

layer2.mapping: Periodic activity pattern informs GSI's temporal forecasting; GSE applies rhythmic state transitions to simulate circadian and hormonal influence.
layer2.telemetry: Daily activity amplitude variation over 4-day window
